tags.acceptance-unmet: The change does not meet a stated acceptance criterion of its card.
tags.apply-gate: A governed apply or its gate ran unrehearsed or read state not filtered to its scope.
tags.contract-break: A schema, CLI or file format changed without a new version or a consumer update.
tags.disk-budget: A process, container or queue had no disk budget and filled a shared disk until other services failed.
tags.entity-filter: A collector listing a directory or table counted non-entities such as hidden or dunder names.
tags.identity-resolution: An identity was re-keyed or resolved wrongly and references to the old key were left behind.
tags.job-failure-streak: A scheduled job failed repeatedly and nothing raised an incident.
tags.missing-test: The behaviour changed but no test fails without the change.
tags.no-failover: A role or dependency had one backend and no failover, so its outage failed every caller.
tags.post-apply-check: A governed apply had no post-check or fast rollback, so only a live run caught the defect.
tags.scope-drift: The change edits files or behaviour outside the scope of its card.
tags.signed-manifest-drift: A signed manifest names a file that was renamed or changed without a re-sign.
tags.stale-config: A hardcoded or copied config value went stale while the canonical source moved on.
tags.stale-deploy: The live build lags the merged source, so a fix on main is not what runs.
tags.stale-evidence: A decision used remembered, old or unbounded-age evidence instead of fresh live evidence.
tags.start-order: Correct behaviour depended on service start order that the units did not encode.
tags.sync-conflict: A file in a synced directory was rewritten when unchanged, causing conflicts or churn.
tags.systemd-oneshot: A oneshot unit was started from code without --no-block, so the caller timed out mid-work.
tags.test-isolation: A test read or wrote live state because HOME or its data dirs were not isolated.
tags.turn-end-wait: An agent ended its turn to wait on CI or a timer and was never woken to finish.
tags.unalerted-failure: A long-running unit or container kept failing, such as a restart loop, and nothing alerted (not scheduled jobs).
tags.unclaimed-work: Work started without claiming its card, so another worker could duplicate it.
tags.uncommitted-work: Finished work was left uncommitted or unpushed in a worktree when the turn ended.
tags.unverified-done: Work was reported done on a status signal without checking the artifact itself.
